title: fix(service-settings): judge the whole fetched page when two data-key files differ, and report a mixed-key database
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg9Xp3HcRyRtEiueJAgv7qVo)_

domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CahkbD22YHPM8hMrA8

Fixes #30091

Clause-②: no — an internal boot heuristic and its notice text. The shapes it changes (`StoredSecretReader` answers the page, `KeyFileChoice` gains the `mixed` reason and a `tally`, `DataKeyOpensNothingError` gains `judged`) were added by #30042, whose changeset is still pending, so they first ship together in the same release; no released export changes, and no new error code is added.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个数据密钥文件不一致时，启动试开不再只看最新一条 `sys_secret`，而是对已取回的最新一页（最多 10 条）逐条用两把钥匙试开，用打开条数更多的那把（平局取能打开最新一条的那把）；两把各开一部分时，按「混合密钥」打一条启动错误，点名两个文件、各开几条和修法；最新一条坏了但较早的行能开时，照常选出钥匙，不再在生产拒启。提示文案改为只说实测到的（「打开最新 3 条中的 2 条」），不再说「打开本库全部已存密钥」。另修三个评审小问题，并在运维文档加一段两文件规则。
- 为什么改：#30087 的试开只判一行。库里两把钥匙的密文并存时，没选中那把下的密钥照样读成「未设置」且无提示；最新一行损坏时，生产启动会拿钥匙问题拒启，即使较早的行足以定夺。
- 风险与回滚：只改启动时选哪个密钥文件的判法与提示，不改任何密文、不重新封装；生产拒启只剩「整页没有一行能被任一把打开」这一种。混合密钥选择提示而非拒启（理由见 Acceptance notes）。回滚即撤本 PR，回到只判最新一行。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-settings/src/local-crypto-provider.ts` 的 `chooseKeyFileByTrialOpen`（平局与 `mixed` 分支）与 `scoreKeyOverPage`；同文件 `storedSecretReaderOverEngine`（现返回整页）；`content/docs/deployment/backup-restore.mdx` 新增的那一段。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run src/local-crypto-provider.test.ts`，预期 74/74 通过，其中 `#30091 — the trial scores both keys over the whole page` 一组 8 条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The trial scores the page, not one row.** `StoredSecretReader` now answers the newest page, newest first (empty = no stored secret); `storedSecretReaderOverEngine` returns every known-marker row of the page it already fetched (`limit: 10`, unchanged) instead of the first. `chooseKeyFileByTrialOpen` opens each row under both keys (`scoreKeyOverPage`, each scope as before) and counts.
- **The verdicts.** One key opens rows and the other none: `opens`, that key's file. Both keys open rows: the new `mixed` reason, the file whose key opens more of them (a tie goes to the key that opens the newest of them, the key sealed with last), with an `error` notice naming both paths, both counts, the consequence and the fix, in every posture. No row opens under either key: unchanged (`opens-nothing`; production throws `DataKeyOpensNothingError`, which now records and prints how many rows it judged). A row that opens under neither key no longer decides anything while another row opens: a corrupt newest row with an older row under one key settles on that key.
- **`KeyFileChoice.tally`** (`judged`, `chosen`, `other`) records what was measured whenever rows were judged.
- **Notice wording.** The two `opens` notices said the chosen file "opens this database's stored secrets"; they now say what was measured ("opens the 3 newest stored secrets", "opens 2 of the 3 newest stored secrets", plus how many open under neither). The refusal reads "neither data key opens any of the N newest stored secrets".
- **Review nits from #30087.** `serve.ts`: the datasource-binder comment and catch no longer claim a provider-construction error lands there (the deferred provider constructs nothing at that point; a key problem surfaces at the secret-field wiring's `resolve()`, which rethrows the production refusal). `service-settings` README: the file tier names `OS_HOME` / `~` expansion, the project's legacy file and the two-file trial. `one-shot-settings.ts`: JSDoc that `resolveExistingDataKey` sets or deletes both channels on `opts.env`, which defaults to the real `process.env`.
- **Operator docs.** One paragraph, "Two key files on one host", in `content/docs/deployment/backup-restore.mdx` right after the existing "A database backup without `OS_SECRET_KEY` is an incomplete backup" callout, the one page that already tells operators the home dir holds the dev-minted key: the two files, what the boot does when they differ, the split and refusal cases, and the remedy. `content/docs/` is devx-owned; this PR adds that one paragraph and nothing else there.
- Changeset `.changeset/30091-data-key-trial-page.md` (`patch`), with a "Supersedes, in the same release" paragraph for #30042's pending note, which quotes the old refusal text.

## Tests

- `service-settings` `local-crypto-provider.test.ts` (+8, describe `#30091 — the trial scores both keys over the whole page, not its newest row`): a split page is `mixed` on the majority key with an error naming both paths, in production and in development (no refusal); a tie goes to the key that opens the newest row, both orders; a corrupt newest row with older rows under one key settles on that key in production; one key opening every row is `opens` with its tally; a page where nothing opens keeps the production refusal and records `judged`; `settleKeyFileChannel` on a mixed page points the channel at the majority file and prints one `console.error`, no warning. The reader-over-engine test now pins the whole page in order, the unknown marker still skipped. Existing trial tests moved to the page reader unchanged in what they assert.
- `cli` `internal-crypto-key-file-channel.test.ts` and `one-shot-settings.pin.test.ts`: their stub readers answer a one-row page (the type change), assertions unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **Mixed-key is an error notice, not a production refusal.** A split database is measured, not guessed: the chosen key opens real rows, and refusing would leave the operator no running server through which to save the minority's secrets again (no tool re-seals from a second key). The refusal posture from #30087 (production refuses when no key opens anything) is unchanged. If the maintainer wants a split database refused in production as well, that is a one-branch change in `chooseKeyFileByTrialOpen` plus a `(narrowing)` declaration; it is raised in the dev report.
- **The page is ten rows.** A database whose split lies only beyond its newest ten rows is still judged by those ten; the notices say "of the N newest", so they claim no more than that.
- No new error class or code: `mixed` is a `KeyFileChoice` reason, and the refusal stays `DataKeyOpensNothingError`.

## Verification

All readings on head `26eb6119` (branch merged with `main` at `ff12aed3`) unless named.

<details><summary>Build, typecheck, tests</summary>

- Build: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli^...' --filter @objectstack/service-settings build`, VERDICT command-exit 0; then `@objectstack/cli` build, exit 0.
- Typecheck: `@objectstack/service-settings` 0 (its `tsconfig` includes `src/**`, tests included), `@objectstack/cli` 0 (with `check:test-typecheck`).
- `service-settings`: 1159/1159 (67 files), on `26eb6119`.
- `cli` unit (`--project unit`): 380/382 files on the first run, the two red files (`published-subpath-console.pin`, `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`) refusing because `packages/cli/dist` was not yet built; after the cli build both pass, 29/29. On `26eb6119` the two cli files this diff edits: 23/23. The cli `integration` layer is declared to CI (no integration file or spawn entry is touched).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

The pins live in `service-settings`, whose tests import `./local-crypto-provider.js` from `src`, so no dist leg applies.

- A, the trial judges only the newest row (`page = (await opts.readStoredSecret()).slice(0, 1)`): 8 red, the whole new `#30091` group.
- B, the production refusal removed (the `throw new DataKeyOpensNothingError(...)` line deleted): 4 red across `local-crypto-provider.test.ts` and `settings-engine-bind-window.test.ts` (#30087's refusal pin and its channels-left-as-they-were pin, the new page refusal pin, and the real-kernel bind-window refusal).
- C, a split page reported as a quiet `opens` (`if (rejected.opens === 0)` forced true): 5 red (mixed ×2, tie ×2, settle-mixed).

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 95 derived families, the same list on the pre-merge head and on `26eb6119`. Each run with its exit code recorded before any pipe; on `26eb6119` all 95 exit 0, and `--ran` answers: 95 derived, 95 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. On the first pass three exited 3 for environment prerequisites (`check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` before `client-react` and seven other dists existed, `check:i18n-coverage` before `connector-slack`'s); after building those packages all three exited 0.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0 on `26eb6119`.

</details>
